Bug_Details:
Avoid importing anything from the 'sun.*' packages. These packages are not portable
and are likely to change.

If you find yourself having to depend on Sun APIs, confine this dependency to as
small a scope as possible, for instance by writing a stable wrapper class around
the unstable API. You can then suppress this rule in the implementation of the wrapper.
Examples:
import sun.misc.foo;
public class Foo {}
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by intentionally using the non-portable'sun.misc.BASE64Encoder' class, which is not part of the standard Java API.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the SunPackageBug class, which uses the BASE64Encoder from the sun.misc package.
